groundClearanceMm.note: Carsales spec table for the EQC 400 (300 kW, 760 Nm, 80 kWh): 'Ground Clearance 142' (unit not printed; mm per the site's convention). CarWale India also gives 142 mm for the 400 4MATIC. EVKX lists 97 mm tied to an air-suspension setting; not used.

Autotijd dimensions page for the G 580 EQ 587 PS AWD (2024-2027): 'Ground clearance 250 mm', 'Wading depth 850 mm' (wading matches Shahnawaz). Mercedes-Benz Canada's G-Class EV page gives 9.8 in (about 249 mm).
Autotijd dimensions page for the EQA 250plus 190 PS (2024-2027, i.e. the H243 facelift): 'Ground clearance 151 mm'. Length 4,463 / width 1,834 / wheelbase 2,729 mm match the DB.

conflicts.note: Autotijd gives height 1,612 mm for the EQA 250plus; likely a different wheel/measurement basis. Not applied.

groundClearanceMm.note: Autotijd dimensions page for the EQB 250plus (2024-2027): 'Ground clearance 135 mm'. Length 4,684 / width 1,834 / wheelbase 2,829 mm match the DB.

conflicts.note: Autotijd gives height 1,673 mm for the EQB 250plus; small difference, likely wheel/roof-rail basis. Not applied.

groundClearanceMm.note: Autotijd dimensions page for the EQS SUV 450+ 360 PS (2022-2027): 'Ground clearance 178 mm'; length 5,125 / width 1,959 / height 1,718 / wheelbase 3,210 mm match the DB. Air suspension is standard, so clearance varies with ride height (Mercedes-Benz USA quotes 7.28 in at max load for the EQS 580 SUV).

torque.note: CarExpert spec page for the 2025 (facelift) Audi S e-tron GT: 'Maximum Power (kW): 500', 'Maximum Torque (Nm): 740'. Same variant as the DB headline (S, 500 kW). Cars-data.com also lists 740 Nm for the S e-tron GT.

groundClearanceMm.note: Autotijd dimensions page for the i4 eDrive35 (2024-2027): 'Ground clearance 125 mm'. Autocar India's eDrive35 listing also gives 125 mm.

Carsales spec table for the Aceman E Classic (135 kW, 290 Nm): 'Ground Clearance 143' (unit not printed; mm). CarExpert's 2026 Aceman page gives 'Ground Clearance Unladen (mm): 143' for the SE and JCW E as well.

Carsales spec table for the 2025 Cooper E Classic (3-door, 135 kW, 290 Nm, 40.7 kWh): 'Ground Clearance 124' (unit not printed; mm). MotoringFile's EU-market table gives 124 mm for the J01 Cooper SE, and CarExpert 124 mm for the JCW E.
